name: BingCard Virtual Exclusive
summary: A high-limit virtual card designed for online transactions and advertising payments without requiring identity verification.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the BingCard Virtual Exclusive charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$25.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the BingCard Virtual Exclusive?
faq.answer: It charges about 1.5% on non-base-currency spending.
